fn drain(control: &mut Consumer<Record>, ticks: &mut core::iter::Repeat<()>) {
    for _ in ticks.by_ref() {
        let available = control.available_at_entry();
        for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            apply(record);
        }
    }
}
